description: Use this when the user asks if an IP address or domain is blacklisted or why mail is rejected as spam. Checks 12 IP blocklists (Spamhaus ZEN, SpamCop, Barracuda, Mailspike…) and Spamhaus DBL for domains, with removal links. For a domain the website and mail server IPs are checked. Read-only, powered by Lanetti Tools.

target.description: Public IPv4/IPv6 address or domain, e.g. 203.0.113.10 or example.com.

name: oma_check_blocklists
title: Check blocklists
